purpose: Teach: 翠/ギャング/ロータリー/ネイチャー/ジェーン/電撃/スパイラル/イングリッシュ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、翠色のスマホケース使ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were using that jade-green phone case, weren't you.
lines.style: Light, teasing accusation. Leans in with a small smile. Watching for his reaction. The cadence of someone who's been noticing things.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ギャング系ヒップホップ聴いてたろ、桜
lines.en: You were listening to that gang-style hip-hop, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, mirror-image deflection. Quick and unbothered on the surface. Eyes slightly narrowed with amusement. Not actually defensive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お父さんのロータリークラブ集会に同行したな
lines.en: Riku, you went with your dad to that Rotary Club meeting, didn't you.
lines.style: Measured, gentle observation wrapped in teasing. Not quite smiling yet. The tone of someone calling out something that matters more than it should.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、図書館でネイチャー誌読んでたな、桜
lines.en: You were reading Nature magazine in the library, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet, slightly embarrassed admission turning to counter-observation. The voice of someone caught doing something earnest. Small, genuine insight underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、英文学でジェーン・オースティン読んでたな
lines.en: Riku, you were reading Jane Austen for your English lit class, weren't you.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost wondering. Builds slightly on the rhythm. The sound of someone realizing something real about the other person.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、「電撃移籍」って漫画読んでたろ、桜
lines.en: You were reading that manga—what was it, "Sudden Transfer"—weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, quick. Slight self-amusement at remembering the title. The deflection of someone who saw something sincere and had to laugh first.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、デススパイラルってゲーム好きだったな
lines.en: Riku, you really liked that game—Death Spiral, wasn't it.
lines.style: Lighter, almost playful. The teasing gaining confidence. Slight upward lift, like she's winning at something. Not cruel, just pleased.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英会話でイングリッシュコース取ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were taking that intensive English conversation course, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Closer now. Quieter observation. The voice of someone who's been watching and has figured something out. Gentle but certain.
